title: First sync after upgrading to the exact-export build needs one export --rebuild when the last own export was committed by the old build
outcome: Document the one-time explicit rebuild after an upgrade and name it in the import refusal when the last own export was made by the old build without a journal.
acceptance: Git task-sync documentation explains when the last own export from the previous build needs one export --rebuild and how to establish the new comparison basis.
The import refusal names export --rebuild as the upgrade recovery, without adopting an unproven commit or weakening divergent-task protection.
A behavioural test commits an old-style export with no retained exact-export journal and verifies the import names the rebuild remedy.
